requirements.title: Hardware-Aware Selection
requirements.description: Host capability read via system-monitor capability/capacity probe (built on internal/hostinventory); cheap ops zero-download; each AI op ships a CPU-capable default; selector surfaces 'needs >=X GB VRAM' and time-warning messaging.

validation.notes: Selector maps probed capability to a fitting model tier
Selection degrades to CPU default and emits warning when GPU absent
